description: Scans whose timestamp equals either boundary value are left out. Only scans strictly between the two bounds count.

b.request: For scans whose `chronotag` text is strictly greater than '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly less than '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (boundary equals excluded), joined to `sites` on `zoneref = zoneregistry`, group by `zoneref` and `typesite`, take the mean of `pressratio` and the mean of `gbsize / spanmin` per group (NULLs ignored), then return one row with the unrounded mean of each set of group averages.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_pressratio) AS mean_pressratio, AVG(g.avg_gb_per_min) AS mean_gb_per_min FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite) g;
b.raw: For scans whose `chronotag` text is strictly greater than '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly less than '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (boundary equals excluded), joined to `sites` on `zoneref = zoneregistry`, group by `zoneref` and `typesite`, take the mean of `pressratio` and the mean of `gbsize / spanmin` per group (NULLs ignored), then return one row with the unrounded mean of each set of group averages.

c.request: For scans taken between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (comparing the `chronotag` text), and only those linked to a site by site code, group by zone reference (`zoneref`) and site type (`typesite`). For each group, get the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) and the average of file size divided by scan duration (`gbsize` / `spanmin`), ignoring missing values. Then give me one row with two unrounded values: the average of the per-group compression-ratio averages and the average of the per-group size-per-minute averages. Scans whose timestamp equals either boundary value are left out. Only scans strictly between the two bounds count.
c.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_press) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_size_per_min) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM grouped;

a.request: Take the scans whose timestamp (`chronotag`, compared as text) is strictly after '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly before '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', with both endpoints excluded, and keep only scans that match a site by site code. Group them by scan zone reference (`zoneref`) and site type (`typesite`). For each group, work out the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) and the average of file size divided by scan duration (`gbsize` / `spanmin`), ignoring missing values. Then give me one row with two unrounded values: the average of those per-group compression-ratio averages and the average of the per-group size-per-minute averages.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_press) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(g.avg_size_per_min) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM (SELECT AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite) g;

d.request: For scans with `chronotag` strictly greater than '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly less than '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (both boundaries excluded), joined to `sites` by `zoneref` = `zoneregistry`, grouped by `zoneref` and `typesite`, averaging `pressratio` and `gbsize / spanmin` per group while ignoring NULLs, then returning one row with the unrounded average of the per-group compression-ratio averages and the unrounded average of the per-group size-per-minute averages.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(g.avg_size_per_min) AS avg_size_per_min FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite) g;
